summary: Frontend-only test of Topbar epure + responsive (it59). Tested 3 viewports via new_context (desktop 1920, tablet 1024, mobile 390). All acceptance criteria validated: no overflow on any breakpoint, mesh-status fused pill visible only at xl (1280+), perimetre-badge is icon-only with title, nav labels only at xl, Nouveau travail label only at 2xl, a-traiter label from sm (640+), Flore label from sm, MERIDIAN wordmark from md, persona from md. Mobile hamburger contains menu-nav-* (atlas/actualites/travaux/jumeaux) and menu-persona-* (architecte/paiements/support) sections. Navigation from hamburger works and closes menu. Persona switch works. Regression on /atlas /travaux /actualites /jumeaux passes. Zero console errors on all viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: Topbar.jsx is 330 lines and handles nav + menu + notifs + périmètre + Flore + persona; consider splitting notification panel into its own component for maintainability (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: It59 validated 100%. Viewports must be set via browser.new_context(viewport=...) — page.set_viewport_size after navigation is unreliable for this app. mesh-status is xl:flex (hidden <1280); perimetre-badge is sm:inline-flex (hidden <640); nav labels xl:inline; Nouveau travail label 2xl:inline (1536+); a-traiter/Flore labels sm:inline; MERIDIAN wordmark md:inline; hamburger sections md:hidden. Mobile 390 header confirmed: point + hamburger + selecteur-perimetre + a-traiter (chiffre seul) + Flore icon + notifs, no overflow.
